channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Privilège Marine Becomes the First Multihull Shipyard to Make SEA.AI Standard Across Its Entire Range
item.description: Privilège Marine, the French shipyard renowned for building some of the world’s most capable offshore cruising catamarans, has named SEA.AI as standard equipment across its entire model range. Privilège Marine is the first multihull shipyard to add AI-assisted situational awareness and collision prevention as a core safety feature of every yacht it builds.

item.title: Strategic Alliance Announced for Caisson Integrity Management
item.description: THREE60 Energy, Innovair, and Oil States have announced a strategic alliance to deliver integrated solutions for caisson integrity management in the global oil and gas sector. The collaboration combines proven inspection, engineering, and repair expertise to provide a seamless, end-to-end service that enhances safety, assures compliance, optimizes operational efficiency and reduces lifecycle cost and complexity for operators.

item.title: Teledyne Valeport Sponsors River Conservation Charity to Inspire the Next Generation of Environmental Leaders
item.description: Teledyne Valeport has announced a year-long sponsorship of UK-registered charity Westcountry Rivers Trust (WRT), which protects, conserves, and restores rivers across the Southwest.

item.title: Robosys Expands Range of OEM Propulsion Control with Sleipner Thruster Integration
item.description: Robosys Automation, a global leader in maritime autonomy and intelligent vessel control solutions, has announced the expansion of its multi-OEM propulsion control capabilities with the integration of Sleipner (Side-Power) Thruster Systems into its flagship VOYAGER AI autonomy and remote vessel control software suite.

item.title: Fulkrum Strengthens South American Footprint with Bogotá Office Opening
item.description: Fulkrum, a global provider of inspection, expediting, auditing, asset integrity management and technical staffing services, has announced the opening of its newest office in Bogotá, Colombia. The new office strengthens Fulkrum’s footprint in South America and supports a recently awarded framework agreement with a major national operator to deliver comprehensive technical assurance services across upstream oil and gas and new energy projects.

item.title: DUG Signs Multi-Client 3D Seismic Data Reprocessing Agreement Offshore East Sarawak Malaysia
item.description: DUG Technology (DUG) in partnership with Searcher Seismic has announced that it has signed an agreement for the provision of multi-client 3D seismic data reprocessing offshore East Sarawak.

item.title: MacGregor to Supply Cargo Access Solutions and Deck Machinery for BC Ferries
item.description: MacGregor has been selected to supply cargo access solutions and deck machinery for four New Major Vessels as part of BC Ferries’ historic fleet renewal plan. These next-generation, diesel-battery hybrid, all-electric ready vessels will be built at China Merchants Industry (CMI) Weihai Shipyard Co., Ltd. The order was booked to MacGregor’s first quarter 2026 orders received.

item.title: American Defense Companies Strike High-Tech Gulf of America Security Partnership
item.description: Two leading American defense firms are striking a strategic agreement to build a high-tech ‘wall of steel’ to support the US Navy, commercial shipping and offshore operations in the Caribbean and Gulf of America.

item.title: Anemoi Marine Technologies Strengthens Technical Oversight Committee
item.description: Anemoi Marine Technologies Ltd (Anemoi) has appointed Lloyd’s Register (LR) Technical Director Claudene Sharp-Patel to its Technical Oversight Committee, bringing a vast wealth of maritime operational expertise and regulatory experience to the non-executive body guiding the design and development of Anemoi’s wind-assisted propulsion solutions.

item.title: HII Teams with Path Robotics to Integrate Physical AI into Manned and Unmanned Shipbuilding
item.description: HII and Path Robotics signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to explore the integration of Path’s physical artificial intelligence (AI) for welding into shipbuilding operations that could accelerate throughput, strengthen the maritime industrial base, and augment the shipbuilding workforce.
